title: Sports Illustrated Oct 26 1981 - Graig Nettles New York Yankees
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Magazines
descriptionText: The product is an original vintage Sports Illustrated magazine from October 26, 1981, featuring baseball player Graig Nettles from the New York Yankees. This vintage sports memorabilia item was manufactured in the United States and is a great collectible for fans of the New York Yankees or baseball enthusiasts. The magazine offers a glimpse into the baseball world of 1981, particularly highlighting the career of Graig Nettles during that time.
